plan: Create Espresso integration tests to verify basic home screen functionality: app launch, video display, like button interaction, loading state, and vertical paging.
steps: Set up test class with @RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class) and ActivityScenarioRule<MainActivity>
Write test to verify app launches and displays home screen without crashing
Write test to verify CircularProgressIndicator appears during loading state
Write test to verify video content is displayed (author text, description, action items)
Write test to verify like button (heart emoji) is clickable and increments the like count
Write test to verify vertical paging works (swipe to next video, verify different author displays)
Write test to verify all action items are visible (author avatar, like, comment, share buttons, music disc)
